description: This file defines a Java class ThingWriteModel used for representing a write model of a 'Thing' in MongoDB, encapsulating the document to be written and methods for creating instances and converting to MongoDB-specific write operations.

classes.name: ThingWriteModel
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, final class representing a MongoDB write model for a 'Thing'. It encapsulates a Document and provides methods for creating the model, converting to MongoDB operations, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ThingWriteModel instance with provided metadata and document.

methods.name: toMongo
methods.description: Converts this instance into a MongoDB ReplaceOneModel object for database write operations.

methods.name: getThingDocument
methods.description: Returns the Document representing the 'Thing' to be written.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates and returns ReplaceOptions with upsert enabled.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object, considering the 'thingDocument' and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on superclass hash and the 'thingDocument'.
